'''''Bothan Buff''''' was a famous painting created by the legendary [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Bahzel]]. Copies of it were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] looking off to stage right with a semi-transparent [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white sunburst pattern superimposed over him. Overall, the painting's style was similar to ''[[Bothan Beauty]]'', another well known work by Bahzel.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MaleBothanConcept.jpg|200px|thumb|Early concept art for a male Bothan, similar to the one used in the painting]]
''Bothan Buff'' is a painting that appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. It can be used in the player character's personal home as decoration. It was made obtainable by players of the game in the ''Hotfix 17.10'' game update on [[October 7]], [[2010]] as part of the "rare loot system," which allows players to obtain exceedingly rare items as loot from any enemy in the game.

The artwork for the painting had existed in the game's files for some time before this, however, and was an edited version of the male Bothan concept art for the game.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref><ref name="Pencil">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref>
